   - Prevents duplicate invoices due to formatting variations

   - Works with various formatting variations

- IDs normalized on input (at API boundary in getCustomer and createInvoice)
- Stored IDs always uppercase without extra spaces
- Prevents data inconsistency from external systems with varying formats
- Backwards compatible with existing uppercase IDs
- Handles all common formatting issues (case, whitespace, special characters)
